summary: Shopify fixes OrderTransaction.totalUnsettledSet for pending captures
details:
OrderTransaction.totalUnsettledSet no longer double-counts a pending capture: for a $100 authorization with a $50 pending capture it returns $100, not $150. The fix applies to all API versions at once and only affects multi-capture orders.

Check any logic that compensated for the inflated totalUnsettledSet on multi-capture orders; the field now returns the amount still capturable.
